behavior: Each of Gen9's 7 images is built once by the workflow for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, pushed to ghcr.io/coast-guide/gen9-<name>, and its provenance and SBOM attestations verify
check: gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/coast-guide/gen9-<name>@<digest> -R coast-guide/gen9, for each image in the lock

behavior: A file in git lists the digest of every Gen9 image a version runs, and both shapes read it
check: the lock against the workflow's output and against docker buildx imagetools inspect

behavior: Each build on main and each release writes the digest of every Gen9 image it pushed into a lock, kept with the run and attached to the release, and both shapes deploy from it
check: the lock artifact of the images workflow's run against docker buildx imagetools inspect of each image's sha tag; the release's asset

behavior: On a host with only Docker, one command runs Gen9 from the lock: images pulled by digest, nothing built
check: the command on this machine after removing every local gen9-* image; make e2e

behavior: The chart installs on kind and Gen9 works there
check: helm install on a kind cluster; make e2e against it

behavior: The same chart, with the same values, installs on k3s and Gen9 works there
check: helm install on a k3d cluster; make e2e's scripts that exercise what differs between clusters (all 49 ran on kind)

behavior: The chart renders only standard Kubernetes kinds (and OpenSandbox's CRDs), valid against the cluster's schemas, nothing tied to a cloud
check: helm template | kubeconform -strict; a list of the kinds rendered

behavior: The Docker shape and the Kubernetes shape run the same image digests, equal to the lock
check: docker inspect and kubectl get pods -o jsonpath against the lock

behavior: The drift command passes on a fresh Docker deployment, and fails naming the service after a container is changed by hand
check: make diff before and after docker update or a container recreated from another image

behavior: The drift command passes on a fresh Kubernetes deployment, and fails naming the object after it is changed by hand
check: make k8s-diff before and after kubectl edit or kubectl set image

behavior: Every setting a deployment may change is listed in one place with its default, and an unknown or misspelt setting is refused
check: the settings reference; helm install with an unknown key fails on the schema

behavior: A stack uses its own Postgres, Valkey or Redis, ClickHouse or S3 elsewhere instead of the bundled one, which then doesn't run, on Docker and on Kubernetes; a store left out with nothing in its place is refused
check: each stack against a store outside it, on Docker and k3d (U5c-1 to U5c-4); a left-out store with no setting refused by make up and the chart

behavior: On Kubernetes a chat's command runs in a sandbox pod with Gen9's egress sidecar, its limits, and its network closed as on Docker
check: e2e/sandbox.mjs against kind; a blocked host refused from inside the pod

behavior: A release tag produces a GitHub Release with notes, the chart, the Compose bundle and the SBOMs, that cannot be changed afterwards, and verifies
check: a pre-release from a branch; gh release verify and gh release verify-asset

behavior: The running version is visible in the API, the web app and the CLI
check: curl the API's version; the web app's About; gen9 --version
